UAE Golden Visa Guide for Tech Founders, IT Experts & Business Owners (Eligibility)

An exhaustive, highly detailed eligibility masterclass on securing the prestigious 10-year UAE Golden Visa for technology entrepreneurs, software engineers, AI specialists, and executive business owners under 2026 federal guidelines.

15 Min Read · Updated July 2026
UAE Federal Authority (ICP) & Ministry of Economy Compliant
Golden Visa Core Pathways
10-Year Self-Sponsored Residency

100% independent residency status. Requires zero national employer sponsor or local guarantor.

1. What Is the UAE 10-Year Golden Visa Program?

The UAE Golden Visa is a long-term residency program introduced under Cabinet Resolution No. 56 of 2018 to position the UAE as a premier global hub for innovation, technology, and capital investment.

Unlike standard 2-year employment or investor visas, the Golden Visa grants a renewable 10-year residency permit that is 100% self-sponsored. It eliminates the need for an employer sponsor, corporate guarantor, or local Emirati partner.

For technology entrepreneurs and senior software leads, the Golden Visa offers complete security of tenure, tax residency benefits, and full immunity from travel absence restrictions.

2. Eligibility for Tech Founders & Startup Owners (AED 2M Rules)

Tech entrepreneurs and startup founders can qualify for a 10-year Golden Visa under three distinct sub-pathways:

Sub-Pathway A: Business Valuation / Capital (AED 2,000,000+)

Owning a registered tech company in Dubai or Abu Dhabi with a total capital valuation of at least AED 2,000,000 (~$545,000 USD), verified through an audited financial report prepared by a licensed UAE auditor.

Sub-Pathway B: Accredited Tech Incubator Endorsement

Obtaining an official approval/recommendation letter from an accredited UAE startup incubator, such as Hub71 (Abu Dhabi), DIFC Innovation Hub (Dubai), or DTEC (Dubai Silicon Oasis), certifying that the startup is an innovative tech venture.

Sub-Pathway C: Successful Venture Exit (AED 7,000,000+)

Founders who have successfully founded and sold a technology enterprise for a total valuation of not less than AED 7,000,000 (~$1.9 Million USD) with Ministry of Economy endorsement.

3. Eligibility for Software Engineers & IT Executives (AED 30k Salary)

Senior technical professionals qualify under the Specialized Talent / High-Salaried Professional category by fulfilling four statutory criteria:

IT Executive Qualification Checklist:

  • Specialized Role: Employment contract as CTO, VP of Engineering, Lead Architect, Principal Developer, or AI Specialist.
  • Basic Monthly Salary: Minimum basic monthly salary of AED 30,000 (~$8,170 USD) verified via MOHRE contract and bank statements.
  • Educational Degree: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or STEM field (attested by MOFA).
  • MOHRE Classification: Classified under MOHRE Occupational Skill Level 1 (Executive/Professional Managerial level).

5. Step-by-Step Nomination & ICP Application Process

Securing a 10-year Golden Visa follows a structured 5-step application process:

  1. Step 1: Nomination Request: Submit an initial nomination application to the Ministry of Economy or the UAE Council for AI.
  2. Step 2: Approval Certificate: Receive the official nomination approval certificate authorizing 10-year residency.
  3. Step 3: Visa Cancellation & Entry Permit: Cancel existing 2-year visa (if currently present in UAE) and issue Golden Visa Entry Permit.
  4. Step 4: DHA VIP Medical & Biometrics: Undergo VIP medical fitness screening and complete ICP biometrics capture.
  5. Step 5: 10-Year Golden Emirates ID Delivery: Receive your physical 10-year Golden Emirates ID card via courier.

6. Exclusive Perks: Family Sponsorship & Unlimited Global Mobility

Golden Visa holders enjoy premium privileges unavailable under standard 2-year visas:

10-Year Family Sponsorship

Sponsor spouse, unmarried sons of any age, daughters of any age, and domestic staff under 10-year visas.

Unrestricted Global Travel

Exempt from the 180-day UAE entry rule; residency remains valid even if residing outside the UAE for over 1 year.

Family Visa Continuity

In the event of the primary Golden Visa holder's passing, sponsored family members can remain in the UAE until the end of their 10-year visa duration.
